lineage.v2_alpha_source: human + AI thematic curation (the owner's themes: AI power, memory/foundry, prediction markets, nuclear/resources, biotech catalysts)

objective: terminal wealth under the declared personality (docs/OPTIMUS_OBJECTIVE.md §0), graded daily vs SPY and vs the frozen twin; the question is whether this alpha source's errors differ from the other five accounts'; no claim of skill

costs.fill_convention: DAY limit at ask x (1+10bps) for buys and bid x (1-10bps) for sells; an unfilled limit is not traded; last trade when the IEX quote is one-sided or wider than 2%

llm_authority: none: an LLM proposes; deterministic code sizes, stops and exits
owner_action_required: not before 2026-10-26 (roadmap §7: no new paper book before then)
archive first: python -m scripts.fleet_v3_prepare --archive (copies fleet_manager state/, decisions.jsonl, grades.jsonl, modes.json, contracts/ with a sha256 manifest; copies, never moves)
write a last broker-truth read: python -m scripts.fleet_manager_run --pass open --roles hack1 (no --live: DRY, reads and records only)
reset hack1 in the broker UI if wanted (paper reset = the owner's act)
teach scripts/fleet_manager_run.py a v3 path FIRST (today it resolves only v1/v2 and would silently fall back to v1 terms for 'v3')
activate = re-freeze this body into fleet_manager/contracts/ with status changed and the seed block filled; check fleet_v3_contracts.activation_diff(...)['same_rule']
set modes.json hack1 contract=v3, maintenance/entries DRY first, LIVE after one clean DRY pass
alpha_source: human + AI thematic curation: the owner's themes, candidates from the Opportunity Explorer's curated lists

inputs.name: Opportunity Explorer receipt
inputs.read: services.opportunities.load_latest (newest by the stamp in the NAME)

selection.rule: at seed, the owner names ONE Explorer list (default human_ai_thematic_v2) and its receipt; its weights are frozen as the v3 book, each clipped at max_name_frac and never renormalised (what is clipped stays cash); bar-defect / stitched names and a second share class of one issuer are dropped; a later list is a new version

exits: horizon (21 sessions from the first v3 fill) -> cash; resting sigma stops

stop_rule.sigma: 63-session sd of close-to-close returns on the bar-defect-screened panel (Alpaca daily bars when a name is not in the panel)
stop_rule.distance: clip(k_sigma x sigma, min_frac, max_frac) of the reference price
stop_rule.never_loosen: a replaced stop is never below the stop it replaces
stop_rule.order: GTC sell stop for the full long quantity; renewed within 7 days of its expiry
stop_rule.why: the v2 rule carried forward: noise-scaled, inside 12%

twin.rule: for each name entered, one partner drawn from that name's size x vol x 12-1 cell as of the entry date, held until the role exits the name; redrawn on death or collision; partner carries the name's weight; 21 draws seeded seed_for(role, j); both legs pay the same cost; graded daily as a virtual book (not executed)

worst_case.sigma_ref_source: max(universe p90, the v2 book's highest sigma)
worst_case.gap_note: a stop is not a floor: an overnight gap fills below it
worst_case.line: 10 x 10.00% x 12% stop = -$12,000 if every stop fills at its distance; 3-sigma day at 6.71% = -$20,126 (capped at 10% -> -$10,000 by scaling gross x0.50); sum|notional|/equity 1.00; no-stop ceiling -$100,000

kill_rule: account drawdown >= 20% from its v3 high-water -> flatten to cash, DEPRIORITIZED; at 63 sessions, excess <= 0 vs BOTH the twin and SPY -> DEPRIORITIZED (no new entries; held names run to horizon). MECHANISM_REJECTED is never issued by this rule
